title: Airwallex button
description: A crisp 6px-rounded button in electric violet, a white outline twin with violet text, and a bare violet text link. The fill eases to a lighter violet, the outline to a faint violet wash, over 0.25s.
notes: sizes: md (40px, the original's default), sm (32px, the phone header), lg (44px, inside the hero field)
block makes it full width on phones where the original does
